propositions: Per-finding Pass-4 coaching gives instance-level fixes without signaling that the enumeration method itself is at fault, causing repeated review passes.
Existing move 12 is always-applicable with no proof obligation, so authors can falsely claim generalization is complete.
Add a new built-in coaching move (key 15) that reframes a named instance as a sample from a population and requires a machine-checkable completeness proof.
Scope the new move via applies_when to criteria G1G2, E4, G6, and A1 where a population actually exists, excluding verifiability criteria.
The change must be addition-only, leaving existing move ids, names, templates, and applies_when unchanged, plus a mirrored docs move-table row.
New focused tests assert the move's id, name, template, trigger set, and applicability on each trigger and empty trigger set.
